configuration.role: prespecified supplementary model; primary HNE-additive remains separate
configuration.selection: first seed selects learning rate by validation AUROC (negative logloss if single class); exact ties retain first candidate
configuration.epoch_selection: unchanged temporal core: validation AUROC with patience12; single-class negative logloss
configuration.ensemble: equal arithmetic mean of all3 fixed seed probabilities at the selected learning rate
configuration.weighting: training-person balanced then class balanced; prior-logit correction before prediction
configuration.threshold: linear90th percentile of ensemble validation negatives; alerts strictly greater
